newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia pull-out sees Turin May cargo down 36pct.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia pull-out sees Turin May cargo down 36pct.

text.p: Cargo traffic handled at Torino-Caselle airport in May fell 36.2 percent to 42,688 tonnes against the same period 1996, the airport authority SAGAT said.
The main reason for the big drop in traffic was the return to Milan Malpensa airport of Alitala Boeing 747 cargo flights from Turin between January-April this year.

Two years ago, the Italian flag carrier's 747F flights were switched to Turin after then Alitalia senior vice-president cargo Sebastiano Bianca expressed dissatisfaction at Malpensa's service standards, say industry observers.

Bianca has since left the airline, service standard improvement promises were given by the Malpensa management and Alitalia decided to return its 747 freighter operations to Milan's long-haul airport, they add.
